collection.title: BMW M3 2014 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a BMW M3 2014 - 2019 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
